thread:
maria: Quick preflight — final check for the orders schema migration tomorrow 03/18 @ 01:00 UTC. We planned a ~45–60m dual-write window + phased backfill. Need deployment owner, smoke checklist, and explicit rollback lead. cc @kevin @jess @sam
kevin: I can own the deploy and the canary run. Proposed timeline: 01:00–01:10 canary (10%), 01:10–01:40 dual-write + backfill (30m), 01:40–01:45 finalize cutover and flip flags. Rollback plan: stop writes to new writer, flip feature flag to old writer, pause backfill jobs, promote warm replica if needed. I'll be on pager. :white_check_mark:
sam: I'll run smoke tests and monitoring (latency, error-rate, replication lag). Smoke commands I plan to run locally: 
```
# basic smoke
curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .status
psql -h db-ro -c "select count(*) from orders where migrated = false;"
# sample user flow
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/orders -d '{"user_id":123, "item":"sku-45"}'
```
jess: I'll kick off and supervise the backfill. Backfill job will start in phased batches; I can pause/resume. Pause command: 
```
kubectl scale job orders-backfill --replicas=0 -n infra
```
I'll also watch DB CPU and replication lag. If lag > 5s or CPU > 75% we throttle batches.
oncall-bot: Reminder — oncall for 03/18 00:30–04:00 UTC is @kevin. Please keep notifications unmuted :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Deployment draft scheduled: 2026-03-18 01:00 UTC by kevin. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orders-migration (canary + phased backfill).
marco: Quick ask — team load suggests we should try to shorten the dual-write to 45m to free capacity during the window. If we shorten, jess will need increased batch size and I'll help with infra throttle rules.
kevin: @marco noted. jess, can you bump batch_size 2x safely? If we hit DB CPU > 70% we revert to original batch size.
jess: I can bump to 2x and monitor. If replication lag or CPU spikes, I'll immediately scale back and post ETA for remaining rows. Also I'll publish a simple progress metric to Grafana panel `orders.backfill.progress`.
maria: OK locking window to 01:00–01:45 UTC (45m). Final owners: deploy=kevin, backfill=jess, smoke=sam, rollback lead=maria. Action items: kevin update deploy job with new window, jess update batch config, sam prepare smoke checklist, everyone join #eng-oncall 15m before. Please ack with :thumbsup: or raise blockers now.
kevin: ack :thumbsup:
sam: ack
jess: ack
marco: ack, will standby for throttle rules
maria: I'll update the calendar invite + pinned runbook snippet in #eng-oncall 30m prior. If anyone needs a dry-run earlier today, ping me and we can run the smoke sequence in staging.
